title: Conjecture on common roots of sorted binomial polynomials
statement: Let $P_n(z)$ denote the sorted binomial polynomial, and call a root nontrivial when it is not the trivial root shared by the relevant polynomials. **Common-root conjecture.** $P_n(z)$ and $P_{n-k}(z)$ share no nontrivial roots for all $n$ and $1\leq k\leq n$. This generalizes the proved case $k=2$ discussed immediately beforehand; the claim is presented as a conjecture, and no resolution is given here.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03082

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2025).
source_name: Owen John Levens, “Polynomials Arising from Sorted Binomial Coefficients”, arXiv:2511.03082 (2025).
